assets.creator: Atomic Acres project
assets.modifications: Fifty-five deterministic project-generated textures: nineteen original albedo surfaces plus eighteen tangent-normal and eighteen roughness companions. Pass 31 adds plaster, timber, gunmetal and painted-metal maps; the 2026-07-22 weapon pass derives seven distinct restrained carbine, SMG, LMG, scattergun, sniper, pistol and machine-pistol PBR finish triplets from project-authored gunmetal pixels with no external imagery.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project / Jigglyclaw
assets.modifications: Original conventional fragmentation grenade authored from Blender primitives with a segmented olive cast body, fuse head, safety lever, pull pin, and ring. No commercial model, texture, or extracted game asset is used. Runtime loading preserves the gameplay collider, fuse, damage, networking, and explosion behavior.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project
assets.format: Three decreasing optimized glTF 2.0 binary LODs with embedded WebP PBR maps and retained lossless source PNG maps
assets.modifications: Project-original four-block red Semtex bundle with woven retaining bands, pressure adhesive, steel detonator, fuse, braided wire, arming lamp, and held/world presentation sockets. Runtime collision, sticking, fuse, damage, and multiplayer authority remain TypeScript-owned.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project / Jigglyclaw
assets.format: glTF 2.0 binary with lossless WebP textures and Meshopt geometry, 35 meshes, 29 exported materials, 44372 triangles, 6 semantic breakable windows, 16 audited house apertures with 144 clearance samples, 3 semantic route landmarks, 2 modeled transit buses, 4 authored large physical cover assets, 2 authored house furnishing sets, 33 embedded project-authored images, 33 deduplicated texture bindings and 20 exported PBR materials
assets.modifications: Atomic Acres-owned complete environment, deterministically regenerated in Blender 5.1.2 from project primitives, project-authored textures and the checked-in TypeScript-derived arena specification. Pass 62 derives the runtime GLB with pinned lossless WebP texture and Meshopt geometry compression, removes the decorative floating house squares, counter strip and upper headboards, eliminates opaque opening lintels from the interior routes, and gives the upper-floor underside a dedicated untextured plaster material so structural edges cannot read as floating timber. Pass 63 replaces facade-spanning corner strips with true corner posts and adds a deterministic nine-ray clearance receipt for every declared house door, passage and window. No commercial model, downloaded model, copied texture, logo, signage, map geometry, audio or extracted game asset is used. Checked-in procedural authority owns collision and ballistics.

assets.modifications: Project-original compound explosive crossbow authored in Blender with transverse curved limbs, cams, compound string, bolt rail, loaded explosive bolt, cassette, compact 1.5x optic and independently authored delivery LODs. Gameplay authority remains TypeScript-owned.

assets.modifications: Project-original first-person operator arms authored in Blender with tactical sleeves, gloves, wrist guards, full fingers/thumbs, wrist display, grip/knife/grenade sockets and an equip-to-inspect action corpus. Runtime camera-space IK remains TypeScript-owned.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project / Jigglyclaw
assets.modifications: Original climbable Rustworks oil-rig environment authored from Blender primitives by the repository generator. Pass 62 derives the runtime GLB with pinned lossless WebP texture and Meshopt geometry compression, reducing it from 9413732 to 6584716 bytes while preserving route metadata. The Pass 60 v3 repair removes eight mixed centre-cover blocks and two unsupported trench crossovers, corrects the former 1.2 metre handrail slabs into supported rails, and authors exactly twenty-four shipping containers: eighteen closed, three open at both ends, and three open at one end. TypeScript boxes remain the collision and ballistic authority; a runtime-authored animated Welsh flag flies above the tower in every graphics profile; the versioned .blend source and generator remain included for deterministic inspection and rebuilding.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project

assets.modifications: Project-original shared Hunter Drone family authored in Blender for standalone player/AI and Swarm presentation. Includes a mounted machine-gun silhouette, four ducted rotors, optic, landing gear, strict local -Z forward metadata, camera/muzzle sockets, propeller/fire/recoil clips, three decreasing LODs, and project-owned albedo/normal/ORM/emissive maps. Gameplay authority remains TypeScript-owned.

assets.creator: Atomic Acres project
assets.format: Four 960x540 eight-second 24 FPS loops, each shipped as VP9/Opus WebM, H.264/AAC MP4 and WebP poster
assets.modifications: Project-original Blender primitive scenes record three helicopter cockpit flyovers and one cat first-person range prowl. The helicopter clips include deterministic bounded flight variation, visible spinning rotor geometry, a modeled dashboard and quiet synthesized rotor harmonics. The cat clip includes clearer ears and paws plus animated illuminated targets. No downloaded model, texture, video, sampled audio, logo or extracted game asset is used.

assets.creator: Quaternius (@Quaternius)
assets.modifications: Swat.gltf is preserved as the reference source. Swat_FirstPersonArms.glb is a Blender 5.1.1 derivative retaining the original arm, hand, finger skin weights and skeleton while removing torso geometry at the authored shoulder seam. The derivative is bundled for continued calibration but is not selected by the current public first-person presentation because it failed the visual grip/framing gate.
